-- Create missing tags first
INSERT INTO tags (name, slug) VALUES
('Gala Event', 'gala-event'),
('Fundraiser', 'fundraiser'),
('South Coast Repertory', 'south-coast-repertory'),
('Costa Mesa', 'costa-mesa'),
('Missouri', 'missouri')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = name;

-- New Swan Festival Gala
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'New Swan Festival Gala' AND t.name IN ('2025', 'Theatre Festival', 'Gala Event', 'Irvine', 'Special Event', 'Fundraiser')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
